params.body:
Replaces #491, rebased on main after #490.

## What

Reported by Ilse (dealer team, 2026-09-16): when a dealer's website shows the shared stock next to his own ("Toon online voorraad"), his own vehicles must always come first, then the partner vehicles, each group in the chosen sort.

The old app (`cutover-baseline`, `website/vehicles.blade.php`) did exactly that: own vehicles, a rule, then the rest. So this pins existing behaviour; there is no decision to record.

## Where it went wrong

- The embed already grouped own vehicles first, but only in the view (`_wcards_slice` splits the collection). The repository query itself sorted a dealer without intern numbers on `created_at` only.
- The public API (`GET /api/v1/public/vehicles?scope=all`), which the old app did not have, sorted everything together: with `sort=price_asc` a cheaper partner car came above the dealer's own cars.

## Change

- `VehicleRepository::applyWebsiteVehicleDefaultOrder`: own-first is now the primary key in both branches (intern numbers or `created_at`), with `vehicles.id` as the last key so infinite-scroll paging is deterministic. The expression lives in `VehicleRepository::ownFirstSql()` so embed and API group the same way.
- `PublicVehicleController::index`: with `scope=all` the own-first key precedes the chosen `sort`; `own_first=0` (validated boolean) gives one continuous list. `scope=own` SQL is unchanged. Facets and counts do not depend on order and are untouched. Documented in the controller docblock (no `docs/api/public-api.md` on main) and in `docs/website-embed.md`.
- Rules R S2-5.3, R S2-5.10, R P3-3.5 updated; finding `2026-09-16-api-mengde-eigen-en-gedeelde-wagens.md` (opgelost, beslist: Ilse).

## Tests

- New `WebsiteOwnVehiclesFirstTest`: repository order with two own + two partner vehicles where partners are newest and cheapest (own first, each group newest first); intern-number branch (own on intern number, partner after despite a higher number); embed page renders own cards before partner cards; embed without shared stock unchanged. The first test fails against `origin/main`.
- `PublicVehicleApiTest`: new test with two own + two partner cars, partner cheapest, `sort=price_asc` and `price_desc` give own first then partners; two pages of two are stable; facets unchanged; `scope=own` unchanged. The existing mixed-order assertion now uses `own_first=0` (it proves the website price, not the grouping).
- Ran: `PublicVehicleApiTest`, `WebsiteOwnVehiclesFirstTest`, `WebsiteIframeHeightTest`, `WebsiteThemeTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest`, `RulesDocsBuildTest` (39 tests, 221 assertions, OK); `SmokeTest` filtered on website/api routes (13 OK). Full `SmokeTest` has 3 failures on `ownvehicle.edit` from a missing `public/js/vehicle/create.js` in the worktree (uncommitted build output), unrelated to this change.

No hot shared file touched. No screenshot: the embed's rendered order was already own-first via the view, so nothing visible changes there; the API change is JSON and covered by the tests.
params.title: Website and public API: the dealer's own vehicles come before the shared stock (rebased, replaces #491)
